question: Is the attainment of the eight powers identified as the essence of the root Kaula?
premises: The eight powers are explicitly named.
Their attainment is equated with the root Kaula.
This identification is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers constitutes the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of mūlakaula in this context is not fully specified.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
